construct: flex-direction: row-reverse at the DEFAULT axis value and row at the other (the carbon.accordion `align` shape, whose default IS the reversed one)
why: LAYOUT_CHANNEL_TO_FIELD — the only reader that turns a captured flex keyword into a Part.layout fact — mapped `row` and `column` only, while VariantLayoutSchema already accepted the reversed spellings and BOTH emitters already lower them (css.ts writes flex-direction verbatim, emit-figma-script's isReversed reverses the compiled children). The base combo's measured keyword had no slot, so the whole channel left as `layout-not-uniform` and Carbon's Accordion drew its chevron on the wrong side in every align=end variant.

canvas.note: the base variant compiles with reversed children; the start variant rides layoutByProp back to plain row
